articles.title: DRAM Prices Explode 401% as One Kilogram Now Costs as Much as 620 Grams of 24K Gold - Wccftech
articles.description: Export prices hit $92,183 per kilogram in August — 12.5 times higher than early 2023 when the AI buildout began.
